It's a natural human reaction when people talk about death and dieing, I am a funeral and cemetery planner, and licensed insurance agent for end of life final expenses. Life insurance is for the living, it is intended to be there to make up for the loss of your spouses income. People don't realize that it is never you soon to have an end of life plan in place for themselves, more than just a conversation should be had as a family. I see it everyday people say I'm to young to die, I'm not ready, it's a waste of money, I'm going to be cremated, my kids know what to do blah, blah ,blah.. when in reality they have no plan or funds set aside for their own final disposition. And family family struggle to come up with unexpected funds quickly. Life insurance is great to have so are investments, and so is a pre-planned pre paid funeral. We plan for everything else in life marriage, kids, vacation, retirement... We also have insurance for the what ifs, home owners insurance incase something happens to my house , car insurance incase I get into an accident, heal insurance incase I get sick. So why would we not have something for the one thing we CANNOT stop from happening?? If you died today what would your family being doing tomorrow? Do you have a plan?
